angle: Unlike the other L10 materials that stay verbal, this 68-minute lecture is the only one that computes a full two-proportion test end to end and then re-reads the same surgery numbers as a confidence interval and as a power demonstration.
angle_detail: Start with [19:17]–[26:32], where the sampling distribution is built and the value 1.99 is set against 1.96 at the 5 percent level. Continue with [33:51]–[44:23] for the interval around 0.14 read from the sample perspective rather than the null perspective. Finish with [44:23]–[54:37] for error types and what larger samples buy; treat the closing algebra from [54:37] as optional practice and watch the normal-approximation leap, which is justified only by the limit theorem.
